status: Provisional independent agent review; not human gold or independent model-family validation.
scope: All 60 after candidates and all 24 must-keep occurrence labels in the 20 saved development turns. Before candidates, malformed-rejection contents, gate/storage/retrieval outcomes, and other turns were not judged.
indexing: Zero-based input row, after-candidate, and original-label indexes. Rows keyed by original input row index.

rubric.source_support: Supported means every asserted component is entailed by the complete source. Unsupported includes unjustified strengthening even without direct contradiction. Ambiguous means an assertion lacks a determinate reading sufficient to judge. A true but incomplete assertion may be supported while giving only partial target coverage.
rubric.complete_coverage: The stored subject/predicate/object preserves actor, relation, value, negation, modality, and target-material event/time qualifications. Evidence quotes cannot replace omitted assertion details.
rubric.composition: Joint credit requires an explicit shared relation/event binding in participating assertions. Same source proximity alone is insufficient.
rubric.label_ambiguity: Ambiguous original targets remain in the denominator and receive no complete credit pending adjudication. Labels are frozen and unchanged.
rubric.unique_accounting: Group only case-scoped subject/predicate logical targets. Rows 6 and 7 repeat the sister-birthday-cake target. Candidate-stage unique coverage uses any complete occurrence; no current-memory or retention claim is made.
rubric.aliases: All equivalence judgments are source-specific; none authorizes storage canonicalization or identity changes.
